Variants.Content: Blizzards can erase roads, landmarks and footprints in a short time, hypothermia people and animals, and cut off supplies. Staying in company, camping with the wind at your back, protecting fires, and avoiding blindly advancing in the white expanse are the basic rules of survival in the northern wilderness; even the most familiar roads may disappear overnight.
